exclusions.source_text: Cardiac ejection fraction \>40% by echocardiogram or multi-gated acquisition (MUGA) scan
Total bilirubin ≤1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) (≤3 × ULN if attributed to lymphoma infiltration of liver)
Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤3 × ULN (≤5 × ULN if attributed to lymphoma infiltration of liver)
Calculated creatinine clearance by Cockcroft Gault formula ≥40 mL/min

Uncontrolled infection with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), or hepatitis C virus (HCV) NOTE: Participants with HIV who have controlled infection (undetectable viral load and CD4 count above 350 cells/μL either spontaneously or on a stable antiviral regimen) are permitted
Another active malignancy (aside from B-cell NHL) in the past 2 years, with the following exceptions

Uncontrolled underlying cardiac conditions including but not limited to: congestive heart failure grade III or IV (by NYHA) or EF \< 45%, unstable angina pectoris, acute myocardial infarction \< 6 months, cardiac arrhythmia
exclusions.threshold: NYHA grade III or IV; EF < 45%; MI < 6 months

exclusions.source_text: Patients with known or suspected CNS involvement or leptomeningeal disease are excluded
Pregnant women or participants unwilling to adhere to institutional guidelines for highly effective contraception during odronextamab treatment and for 12 months after the last dose are excluded
